opening: All 5 A_PUBLIC and 8 V4 native choice changes in the 192-scenario standard set involved an exact top-score tie in B or the candidate. The same final hidden states read through a full-vocabulary FP32 output projection produced 3 changes for each candidate, with no exact four-option top ties. This shadow readout also introduced new changes: it does not erase the native outcomes or establish improved model quality. All original results remain unchanged; this is a post-hoc, same-input diagnostic.
